About

Product Designer with 3 years of experience

I used to measure a good week in polished screens. These days I measure it in questions answered — user research, in-depth interviews, and usability testing that tell a team what to build, not just how to make it look good. I've shipped products across banking, healthcare, SaaS, and AI.

Currently at UKRSIBBANK, where I lead workshops, run research sessions, and push for more UX ownership across cross-functional teams in Product, IT, Marketing and Customer Care.

Based in Kyiv, Ukraine. Open to remote collaboration worldwide.
